description: This source file defines the ShippingMethod controller class for the Opencart e-commerce platform. It handles API requests related to shipping methods, including validating input, setting selected shipping options, and retrieving available shipping methods based on the user's session data.

classes.name: ShippingMethod
classes.description: Controller class for managing shipping method API endpoints within the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles setting the shipping method for the current session based on POST data, performing validation, and returning success or error messages.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available shipping methods for the current user's session, validating customer and shipping address information.
